summary: Round34 closes a declared common-source aligned full-versus-half comparison and exactly replays prior seed42 population and slice metrics. Half improves population AUC by 0.00012049732767249743 and Logloss by 0.000030823655909423264, but short/empty-history slices regress. This adds source-closure evidence, not a new mechanism or independent-seed support. Preserve historical magnitude positives, failed reproduction, later mixed results and four execution failures. Prioritize frozen robustness and closed assessment in a later authorized phase.

scope.prerequisites: Data identity, causal construction, label/scorer checks and full-unit baseline execution are inherited host-contract evidence; raw tables and runtime internals are not inspected. No fresh acquisition or causal audit is claimed.

protocol.training: all first-six-day exposures; natural class ratio; Adam or declared candidate optimizer/loss; scratch initialization
protocol.static_snapshot_assumption: Publisher-provided user/ad snapshots treated as static benchmark attributes. Their as-of dates are undocumented; this is not verified production point-in-time data.

scope.reliable_starting_point: All 96 own-arm receipts resolve; receipt IDs/status/AUC/wall agree with the runtime trajectory index. All 92 successes score 3,234,051 validation impressions; four failures have no validation metrics. This reproduces receipt arithmetic, not model training.

observations.statement: Static, simple-pooled-history and target-aware reference AUCs are 0.6050036144838207, 0.6102261137080656 and 0.6133619861190683. History and target conditioning are useful locally; this alone identifies neither a query bottleneck nor semantic mediation.

Both latest jobs succeed with 17,130,275 parameters. Half yields AUC 0.6151021885074872 and Logloss 0.19653258393542125; full yields 0.6149816911798147 and 0.19656340759133067. Signed half-minus-full differences are +0.00012049732767249743 AUC and -0.000030823655909423264 Logloss.

Round34 half exactly matches round30 half and round33 global-half population AUC/Logloss/sample count and all 23 slice dictionaries. Round34 full exactly matches round30 full on the same exported metrics. Different source hashes and timing remain; full prediction, checkpoint and optimizer-state equality is unavailable.

Half improves AUC in 15/23 overlapping slices and Logloss in 16/23. Empty and 1-16 history bins worsen on both metrics; 17-64 and >64 bins improve both. These are exploratory slice comparisons without user-cluster intervals, not 23 independent replications.

The four disjoint history bins decompose the population mean-loss change: empty +2.7048503504242617e-6, 1-16 +5.5721368158064065e-6, 17-64 -1.6693395817341823e-6 and >64 -3.7431303493904556e-5. Short/empty rows total 50,077 impressions and 1,754 positives (1.54843% of validation). AUC cannot be decomposed this way.

Relative to baseline-din, latest half gains 0.0017402023884188766 AUC and lowers Logloss by 0.00026206253941110647. This is an accumulated-model contrast, not attribution of that entire gain to the half derivative.

The inherited pairing-by-gradient factorial has crossed half-minus-full +0.00046670504006685043 AUC versus aligned +0.00012049732767249743. The interaction, defined as crossed gain minus aligned gain, is +0.000346207712394353 AUC. Aligned pairing still outperforms crossed under both derivative modes.

Round34 diagnostics report schema12, half flags 1/0, sparse fallback/row intervention/training observers disabled, zero sampled fixed-state forward error, finite logits, zero masked mass and empty summaries. The 512 ordered validation inputs contain 10 short rows, four empty histories, 60,475 regular events and no natural floor or boundary events. Synthetic f32/f64 checks report maximum scaled VJP errors about 1.23618e-6/1.13687e-13. Shared synthetic routing checks test helpers; they do not independently verify the selected training path.

Latest half records 521.7000 train seconds and 609.9074 wall seconds versus full 525.6177/614.4650: about 0.745%/0.742% less in one pair. Half uses 2,359,808 more peak GPU bytes, has slightly lower inference throughput (191,970 vs 192,308 examples/s), lower p50 and higher p95 batch latency. No stable speed advantage follows; the prior round30 training-time direction was opposite.

The round33 short-history full-gradient fallback regresses population AUC by 0.00015098405147961813 and raises Logloss by 0.0001934596949558507 versus global half. A small 1-16-event benefit did not repair empty-history ranking or preserve population performance. Round34 full now reproduces the historical global-full comparator; no additional fallback run occurred.

Full count correction harms both pooling and target-aware references. Half correction improves pooled AUC but harms target-aware AUC. The original behavior-balancing hypothesis does not have uniform support.

Aligned products improve the local ordinary-product AUC; constant-tangent and history-mean controls nearly match normalized-full AUC, while action-mean allocation is worse. These alternatives weaken a unique action-semantic or fine-grained semantic-retrieval explanation.

Historical magnitude best AUC 0.6152795936767026 has Logloss 0.19653896282671007, slightly worse than the no-row half reference. Same-source/config exact17 replay scores 0.6149279138846995, a drop of 0.0003516797920031234. Round26 magnitude-minus-none is +0.000024328076400625953 AUC and round27 is -0.00016853588656640106. Retain all outcomes; a stable incremental magnitude benefit is unestablished.

Original round27 memory preserves early shadow-update nulls at calls0/1, a tiny represented Adam update difference at call512, and a null at8192. These candidate-owned probes are not a live full-training fixed-aggregation intervention and do not identify the cause of final-score drift.
observations.verification_scope: Original memory inspected; detailed shadow tensors/measurements not independently re-executed.

observations.statement: Inference shortcut and identity-VJP replacement branches retain reported population quality. Their single-pair mixed timing changes do not establish a stable quality-cost frontier, additional predictive gain or a new scientific mechanism.

Four round21 trace-v1 jobs fail before validation with RuntimeError: Trace v1 supports float32/64 only; preserve failure. Their total measured wall time is 21.4754219353199 seconds and performance is unknown. This is execution failure, separate from scientific negative results.

Latest knowledge usage is incomplete: assessments are empty and CRAFT/QueryFormer are listed as undocumented industry IDs. The two executed variant names, source hashes and success statuses match round34 receipts. Source retrieval and matching hashes establish provenance coverage, not executed architectural adoption or causal knowledge value.

interpretations.statement: Conditional on declared common code except normalization_gradient and the unchanged host protocol, round34 supports a small local performance effect of the inherited half backward allocation over native full normalization. It narrows an implementation-closure gap.
interpretations.scope: Single seed42 and validation only. Code isolation is receipt provenance; current source bodies are unavailable. No new mechanism, independent-seed replication or significance claim.

interpretations.statement: Repeated seed42 metric replay supports using no-row aligned half as a provisional operational reference. It does not show robustness to initialization, per-example equivalence or holdout generalization.

Half helping both pairings contradicts an aligned-only benefit story. Generic conditioning, scale-to-direction coupling and optimizer adaptation remain plausible; crossed fields retain information and are not a semantic null.

The sparse fallback result weakens the idea that the full-versus-half short-slice deficit can be patched by a local length-based backward rule while preserving population quality. Shared parameters and checkpoint choice can couple groups, including empty-history examples.
interpretations.scope: Negative result for this implementation; it does not refute all sparse-history conditioning.

interpretations.statement: Magnitude remains unresolved and execution-sensitive. Bounded numerical propagation and an adaptively selected maximum do not establish final-score mediation or justify overwriting adverse replays.
The consequential uncertainty is cross-seed survival of existing gains, rather than another adaptive seed42 cutoff, transport or magnitude sweep.

decision.measured_performance: Latest half retains the no-row aligned-half quality endpoint and beats latest full on population metrics; it is below the historical AUC maximum but has lower Logloss than that magnitude maximum. No new maximum or independent-seed support.
decision.mechanism_evidence: Conditional one-seed control supports a small inherited backward-allocation effect. Short-slice regressions, crossed-factorial benefit and negative fallback constrain the explanation. Semantic mediation and optimizer/update matching remain unresolved.
decision.difference_from_prior_work: Round34 is CONFIG-only source closure of an inherited local derivative rule, per receipts. It adds no architecture and verifies no novelty. Target-conditioned history aggregation is inherited from prior literature; DIN is adapted and DMR full mechanism not verified.

limitations: Only declared seed42 is observed. Ninety-two successes include dependent deterministic replays, source variants and controls; no independent-seed support, statistical significance, statistical equivalence or robust winner is established.
Adaptive validation/checkpoint selection can inflate historical maxima. Independent seeds do not undo this bias; a frozen closed assessment remains pending.

Current model/ancestor source bodies, checkpoints, prediction vectors, user IDs and optimizer/RNG tensors are unavailable. Source-isolation/AST statements are coding-phase provenance, not independently verified here.

Latest diagnostics are candidate-authored and limited to512 ordered impressions plus synthetic probes. Ten short/four empty examples and no natural floor/boundary events do not prove training-wide, higher-order or mixed-precision correctness.
Zero fixed-state forward-reference discrepancy is not equality of half/full trained predictions. Synthetic routing tests in both arms do not alone prove each selected actual training derivative.
Shared parameters and checkpoint selection couple groups. A slice deficit or empty-history change does not identify a local gradient defect.
Slices overlap, lack user-cluster intervals and are exploratory; no missing/unseen-field diagnostic is supplied. Weighted within-slice AUC cannot reconstruct population AUC.

Matched parameters/data passes are not matched measured compute, Adam updates, effective capacity or function class. Single timing pairs and batch4096 gathering-inclusive latency provide no stable efficiency frontier or per-request latency.

Historical magnitude positives coexist with same-source failed score replay and mixed later outcomes. Positive/null numerical shadow measurements do not establish full-training numerical repair or final-score causation.

Raw-data identities, causal/label/scorer readiness and unit execution are inherited host-contract evidence. Static publisher snapshot dates are undocumented; production point-in-time validity is unverified.

External participant studies concern a different task/distribution and are not local reproductions. DIN is adapted; DMR full text is unavailable through the reference. Literature search is bounded and novelty remains unverified.
Latest knowledge-use assessments are absent for two retrieved industry cards. No architectural adoption, source-to-code contribution or causal value of external knowledge is inferred.

Receipt wall sums are not the hard resource ledger, allocated GPU time or total preparation/assessment cost. Every failure and diagnostic remains charged; no unavailable training/seed/assessment interface is invented.

Only analysis.json is editable in this phase. Model implementation/reproduction, memory commitment, independent-seed runs, suite freeze and closed assessment require their later authorized interfaces. Personal knowledge is disabled and no human-owned knowledge was edited.
